skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of energy resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of forest resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of marine resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of land resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of water resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of agricultural resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of wildlife resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of ecotourism resources.
Understand the characteristics, roles, and economic allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation of biological diversity resources.
Apply knowledge and skills to analyze and solve specific economic problems related to resource allocation, exploitation, use, and conservation.
Demonstrate independent work ability, personal responsibility, and responsibility towards group work.
Express and defend personal opinions based on objective and scientific approaches.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics when making judgments and evaluations on professional issues.
